subject.title: control-ui: expose reply-to metadata to agent sessions and avoid confusing no-output completion notices

question: Should this combined Control UI issue remain the umbrella for structured reply metadata plus no-output completion semantics, or should it be split after the reply-metadata PR and final-delivery policy work are resolved?
rationale: The remaining work crosses Control UI protocol, agent runtime context, channel reply semantics, and final delivery policy, so automation should not choose the permanent contract or tracker shape.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Until Contracts Land
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers review or replace the structured reply-metadata PR and settle the final no-output fallback policy.

options.title: Split To Canonical Items
options.body: Close this only after maintainers confirm the reply-metadata PR or issue and a separate final-delivery issue fully own the two halves.

options.title: Narrow To Quote UI
options.body: Treat current Markdown quote behavior as sufficient for Control UI replies and intentionally drop the structured reply metadata ask.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Until Contracts Land
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers review or replace the structured reply-metadata PR and settle the final no-output fallback policy.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the broadest recent history across UI send flow, prompt envelope, and incomplete-turn delivery code touched by this combined decision.
